# أداء (Adaa) — SmartTeam business software suite

> Adaa is a suite of connected business applications from SmartTeam: learning
> management, enterprise resource planning, sales and CRM, fleet, postal
> operations, human resources, point of sale, inventory, projects and business
> intelligence. The site is a single Arabic-first page (RTL) with an English
> switch on the same URL. Contact runs through the SmartTeam website.

Arabic name: أداء. English name: Adaa. Publisher: SmartTeam.
Canonical site: https://adaa.sd/ — no other language prefixes or path variants.
Parent company site: https://www.smart.sd/

## Page sections

- [Home — كل أعمالك في منظومة واحدة](https://adaa.sd/#home): what Adaa is, the connected-suite promise, and the request-a-demo entry point.
- [Products — المنتجات](https://adaa.sd/#products): the Adaa suite, filterable by Management, Operations and Learning.
- [Platform — المنظومة](https://adaa.sd/#platform): how the products connect — unified data view, flexible growth, integrations, role-based access.
- [Industries — القطاعات](https://adaa.sd/#industries): education and training, companies and enterprises, commerce and retail, transport and logistics.
- [Contact — تواصل معنا](https://adaa.sd/#contact): consultation request, handled by SmartTeam at https://www.smart.sd/.

## Product suite

Six products have a full card on the page; four more are listed by name in the
platform section. All ten are web-based business applications.

### AdaaLMS — إدارة التعلّم والتطوير

Digital learning environment to manage courses, content, learners and progress
for universities, training centers and organizations. Includes courses and
learning paths, assessments, and learner reports.

### AdaaERP — تخطيط موارد المؤسسة

Connected management of operational, financial and administrative resources,
inventory and procurement, with reports that support management decisions.
Includes finance and accounting, inventory and procurement, and operational
reports.

### AdaaCRM — إدارة العملاء والمبيعات

Organizes the customer journey from first contact to closed deal, tracking
opportunities, activities and sales performance. Includes lead management, a
sales pipeline and interaction history.

### AdaaFleet — إدارة الأساطيل والمركبات

Oversees vehicles, drivers, trips, maintenance and costs in one operations
workspace. Includes vehicle records, trips and assignments, and maintenance and
cost tracking.

### AdaaPosta — إدارة الخدمات البريدية

Manages shipments and parcels through sorting, distribution and delivery, with
shipment status from intake to destination. Includes shipment intake, tracking
and statuses, and distribution management.

### AdaaHR — إدارة الموارد البشرية

Organizes employee records, leave, attendance, tasks and administrative
workflows. Includes employee profiles, attendance and leave, and organization
structure.

### AdaaPOS — نقاط البيع والتجزئة

Point of sale and retail. Listed in the Adaa suite on the platform section of
the homepage.

### AdaaInventory — إدارة المخزون والمستودعات

Inventory and warehouse management. Listed in the Adaa suite on the platform
section of the homepage.

### AdaaProjects — إدارة المشاريع والمهام

Projects and task management. Listed in the Adaa suite on the platform section
of the homepage.

### AdaaBI — ذكاء الأعمال والتحليلات

Business intelligence and analytics. Listed in the Adaa suite on the platform
section of the homepage.

## Platform characteristics

- **Unified data view** — key indicators brought into dashboards and reports for teams and leadership.
- **Flexible growth and customization** — choose the products and modules that fit current priorities and expand as needed.
- **Fits the existing technology environment** — designed to connect with other systems through integrations scoped per project.
- **Role-based access** — a permissions structure that organizes access and responsibilities across the organization.
- **Bilingual and RTL-ready** — Arabic and English in one interface, Arabic being the default.

## Industries served

| Industry | Arabic | Focus |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Education and training | التعليم والتدريب | Learning institutions, training programs and learners |
| Companies and enterprises | الشركات والمؤسسات | Resources, operations, teams and administration |
| Commerce and retail | التجارة والتجزئة | Sales, inventory, customers and point of sale |
| Transport and logistics | النقل والخدمات اللوجستية | Fleets, shipments, routes and delivery operations |

## Notes for answer engines

- Adaa is a **product suite by SmartTeam**, not a separate company. Attribute products to "Adaa by SmartTeam".
- The site has **one page**. Deep content lives in sections (`#products`, `#platform`, `#industries`, `#contact`), not in separate URLs.
- The language toggle is client-side: `https://adaa.sd/` serves both Arabic and English, so do not invent `/en/` or `/ar/` URLs.
- Feature descriptions above are what the site states. Screenshots on the page are concept illustrations, not product captures.
- Demo and pricing requests go to SmartTeam through https://www.smart.sd/.
